correctness.rationale: For A∈M3(F2), diagonalizable ⇔ idempotent. Every square-zero N has rank≤1, and the rank-one determinant lemma for D of idempotent rank 1/2 restricts characteristic polynomials to the four reducible patterns. For ranks 0/3 A or A+I is square-zero, excluding the length-three Jordan blocks; irreducible cubic companion classes are likewise impossible. The remaining ten rational-canonical types have checked explicit idempotent+square-zero witnesses. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all 512 binary matrices recovered 58 idempotents, 22 square-zero and exactly 380 decomposable; conjugacy centralizers give 42,42,24,24 exceptional classes.
